description.english: Pradosham (Pradosha Vrata) is observed on the 13th lunar day (Trayodashi tithi) of both fortnights each month — occurring twice a month. The fast is particularly observed in the Pradosha Kala, the 1.5-hour window around twilight (roughly 4:30–6 PM). This is when Lord Shiva and Parvati are in a joyful, dancing mood and readily grant boons to devotees.
description.hindi: प्रदोष व्रत प्रत्येक पक्ष की त्रयोदशी को किया जाता है। प्रदोष काल — सूर्यास्त से 1.5 घंटे पहले — इस समय भगवान शिव की पूजा करना अत्यंत फलदायक है।
description.telugu: ప్రదోషం ప్రతి పక్షంలో త్రయోదశి నాడు జరుపుకుంటారు. సూర్యాస్తమయానికి ముందు 1.5 గంటల ప్రదోష కాలంలో శివుని పూజ అత్యంత ఫలప్రదం.

specialVariants.name: Soma Pradosham
specialVariants.note: Exceptionally auspicious — Monday is already dedicated to Shiva

specialVariants.name: Bhauma Pradosham
specialVariants.note: Powerful for removing debts, enemies, and health issues

specialVariants.name: Shani Pradosham
specialVariants.note: Extremely auspicious; Lord Shani and Shiva together remove hardships

whatToAvoid: Consuming food during the Pradosha Kala itself — fast through the puja window

english: Begin the fast at sunrise or from the previous evening (Dwadashi night)
Bathe and wear clean white or light-colored clothes
Visit a Shiva temple during the Pradosha Kala (roughly 4:30–6 PM) — this is mandatory if possible
Circumambulate the Shivalinga 7 times during the Pradosha Kala
Offer bilva (bel) leaves, white flowers, milk, and water to the Shivalinga
Chant 'Om Namah Shivaya' 108 times or recite the Panchakshara Stotram
Light a ghee lamp and incense before Shiva and Nandi
Break the fast after completing the Pradosha puja, with a simple sattvic meal

significance.english: It is said that whatever boon a devotee seeks during the Pradosha Kala will be granted by Lord Shiva. The Shiva Purana states that fasting on both Pradoshams of a month is equivalent to performing a major yajna. Regular observance destroys sins, removes obstacles, grants health, wealth, and harmonious family life, and ultimately leads to liberation (moksha).
significance.hindi: प्रदोष काल में शिव की पूजा करने से मनोकामनाएं पूर्ण होती हैं। शिव पुराण के अनुसार, इस व्रत का फल यज्ञ के समान है।
significance.telugu: ప్రదోష కాలంలో శివుని పూజించిన భక్తుల కోరికలు తప్పకుండా నెరవేరతాయని శివ పురాణం చెప్తుంది.
